record.dic_text:
08439 Towla` {to-law'}

與 08438 同 ; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Tola 6; 6

陀拉 = "蟲"
1) 以薩迦的長子, 陀拉族的始祖
2) 以薩迦族人, 普瓦的兒子, 是繼亞比米勒以後的以色列士師 (#士 10:1 |)
record.edic_text:
08439 Towla` {to-law'}

the same as 08438;; n pr m

AV - Tola 6; 6

Tola = "worm"
1) the 1st born of Issachar and progenitor of the family of Tolaites
2) a man of Issachar, son of Puah and judge of Israel after Abimelech
